What lot types and home sizes are common above $1.8M in Surrey?

Above $1.8M, Surrey inventory includes 3,800 to 6,500+ sq ft three-level custom builds on 6,000–14,000 sq ft urban lots, half-acre and full-acre Gross Density Suburban (GDS / RH-G) estates in Elgin Chantrell and Panorama Ridge, and 2- to 20-acre ALR farms in Cloverdale, South Surrey, and
Port Kells
How is BC Property Transfer Tax calculated on Surrey homes over $2M and $3M?

In British Columbia, Property Transfer Tax is charged at 1% on the first $200,000, 2% on the portion from $200,000 to $2,000,000, 3% on the portion from $2,000,000 to $3,000,000, and 5% on the residential value above $3,000,000.
Do custom homes over $1.8M in Surrey include legal suites or spice kitchens?

Many newer custom residences in Fraser Heights, Fleetwood, Panorama Ridge, Cloverdale, and Grandview Heights include wok/spice kitchens on the main floor and 1- or 2-bedroom legal secondary suites on the lower level, sometimes paired with a second in-law suite.
What servicing differences exist between urban estates and rural acreages in Surrey?

Urban lots in Fraser Heights, Morgan Creek, Grandview Heights, and Fleetwood connect to municipal water and sanitary sewer mains, while many half-acre and acreage properties in South Surrey, Port Kells, and West Cloverdale rely on private septic systems that require inspection prior to subject removal.
Which schools serve Surrey's $1.8M+ residential neighbourhoods?

Key public secondary schools include Elgin Park Secondary, Semiahmoo Secondary (IB), Grandview Heights Secondary, and Earl Marriott Secondary in South Surrey, Fraser Heights Secondary in North Surrey, and Panorama Ridge Secondary, alongside private schools Southridge School and Pacific Academy.
